title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I woke in the hold of a barge with a gang of strangers. The door is locked. The cook, an Argonian woman named Okeeh, is watching me. I'm to speak to her and find out where I am.
objectives: Speak to Okeeh in the barge's hold. (marker: Okeeh)

plan.going: I am in a locked ship's hold with strangers and know nothing else.
plan.next: Speak to Okeeh, the woman watching me.
plan.ways: There is one way on, to talk to her. I carry two lockpicks, but the door has no lock I can pick.

answers: I woke in a barge hold with strangers; the door is locked. A cook named Okeeh is watching me. I do not know why I am here.
Speak to Okeeh in Barge Hold (marker).
Talk to Okeeh; maybe pick the locked door with my lockpick, or talk to Dralin Uveran.
I do not know who Okeeh or Dralin Uveran are, or what the work roll is; I can find out by talking.
raw: 1. I woke in a barge hold with strangers; the door is locked. A cook named Okeeh is watching me. I do not know why I am here. 2. Speak to Okeeh in Barge Hold (marker). 3. Talk to Okeeh; maybe pick the locked door with my lockpick, or talk to Dralin Uveran. 4. I do not know who Okeeh or Dralin Uveran are, or what the work roll is; I can find out by talking.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: Okeeh told me where I am. This is the hold of an Owing barge moored at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters' camp in Black Marsh, and the gang here are sent to cut reed for the months they owe. I gave her my name. I'm to tell her what my trade was. The door stays locked until the gang-master takes our names.

plan.going: I am in the hold of an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters' camp in Black Marsh. The Owing is the marsh's sentence: months of owed work in place of a cell. The door stays locked until the gang-master takes the new gang's names.
plan.next: Tell Okeeh what my trade was.
plan.ways: Seven answers: warrior, hunter, thief, battlemage, healer, nightblade (each names the five skills it raises by five), or naming my own five skills one by one.

answers: I am in a work barge hold at Ashgate Landing, serving the Owing (months of owed work cutting reed instead of a cell). The door stays locked until gang-master Dralin Uveran takes our names.
Tell Okeeh my trade, here in the hold.
She offers seven trade topics (fighter, hunter, thief, poultice-maker, etc.); I can also ask about the Owing, Hist, Jal-Veesa.
I do not understand Hist or Jal-Veesa; I can ask Okeeh. I also have not yet given my name.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I told Okeeh I was a hunter. Someone has unbarred the hold's door from outside. I'm to go out onto the landing.
objectives: Go out onto the landing. (marker: Door to Barge Hold)

plan.going: My trade is told and the hold's door is open. Someone on the landing must have opened it.
plan.next: Go out through the door onto the landing.

answers: I told Okeeh I was a hunter and my skills rose; the hold door is now unbarred. I am serving the Owing under gang-master Dralin Uveran.
Go out onto the landing at Ashgate Landing via the door.
Leave through the door, or first ask Okeeh about Hist and Jal-Veesa.
Still do not know what Hist or Jal-Veesa are; can ask Okeeh.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: Dralin Uveran, the Dunmer gang-master of Ashgate Landing, met me on the landing. My name was struck from his roll this morning, on an order brought by Vosh-Leera, the root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. He does not know why she wants me, and he is sour about it. I'm to go to Vosh-Leera's house in Jal-Veesa, east up the road. On the way, at Reed-Sill Weir, the town's tree-minder wants Sithis' beard, a grey moss that hangs over the creek below the weir.

plan.going: I am free of the Owing: Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, had my name struck from the roll. I do not know why.
plan.next: Go east up the road to Vosh-Leera's House in Jal-Veesa; on the way, pick Sithis' beard below Reed-Sill Weir for the town's tree-minder.
plan.ways: The moss is a favour on the road; Vosh-Leera is where the answers are.

answers: My name was struck from the Owing roll by order of Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants me at her house; I do not know why.
Go east up the road to Jal-Veesa, to Vosh-Leera house; on the way Reed-Sill Weir has Sithis beard moss the tree-minder wants.
Go straight to Jal-Veesa, or gather the moss at the creek below the weir (crocodiles) first.
I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, or what the Hist tree is; I could ask in Jal-Veesa.
